proportion_source.label_note: The 2 TON rating is legible in the photo and the reference. Small print, certification marks and the original artwork are not reproduced.
proportion_source.pixel_ratios: Clean-photo alpha and the six-view panels give gross proportions only. The reference panels disagree on handle pose (upright in front/back panels, horizontal in side panels); the candidate follows the photo and side panels (horizontal operating handle) and marks the pose as inferred.

frame.note: Side-plate outline follows the side reference and the photo. Angled top edge, nose radius and stamped rib are approximate.

wheels.note: Two large front wheels on a through axle and two small rear swivel casters. Wheel diameters, tyre section and caster offset are inferred from photo/reference ratios, not measured.

arm.note: The lifting arm is a tapered welded beam. The exact section and internal reinforcement are inferred.

head.note: Black lifting head, link plates and pivot pins are partly inferred; the photo shows the head, pin and cotter pin but not the hidden inner faces.

saddle.note: Knurled/scalloped saddle pad. The tooth count and dish depth are inferred.

pump.note: Black hydraulic pump/valve cover with a recreated 2 TON label. Internal pump, release valve and relief passages are hidden and not modelled as flow passages.

socket.note: Black cast handle socket with side ears and two plated bolts. The internal latch is hidden and inferred.

handle.note: Red tubular handle shown in the horizontal operating position, with a black rubber grip. The reference front/back panels show the handle upright; that pose is not used. Handle length beyond the photo crop is inferred.

loop.note: Yellow U-shaped carry handle across the frame, leaning slightly forward. Exact tube diameter, lean and mounting detail are inferred.

labels.note: Labels are recreated from legible text; small print and certification marks are absent.
